question:
Read the given sentence carefully. Change the meaning of the sentence by replacing the underlined word with its ANTONYM from the following options.

The __equivocal__ tone of the Prime Minister in his speech caused uproar in the chamber.
solution:
The correct answer is: **explicit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"equivocal"** means something that is ambiguous or open to more than one interpretation; not clear or decided. (संदिग्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **Her answer was equivocal, leaving everyone confused about her true intentions.
 
 
 
• **"Explicit" **refers to something that is stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were explicit, so everyone knew exactly what to do.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'equivocal' **is **'explicit'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **explicit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conflicting **(विरोधाभासी): Incompatible or at variance; contradictory.

 
 
• **Example:** The two reports were conflicting, making it hard to know which one to trust.
 
 
 
• **Irresolute **(अस्थिर): Showing or feeling hesitancy; uncertain.
 
 
• **Example: **He stood irresolute at the crossroads, unsure of which path to take.
 
 
 
• **Iffy** (अनिश्चित): Full of uncertainty; doubtful.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather forecast looks iffy, so the picnic might be canceled.
